info.name: TBO Live Verified - Hotel Certification FULL Pack (8 Cases)
info.description:
Live TBO collection updated from the old auto-chaining pack.
Tested live on 2026-07-08 from the whitelisted production server.
Production auth now uses the live auth endpoint and the live hotel login:
  - Auth URL = https://api.travelboutiqueonline.com/SharedAPI/SharedData.svc/rest/Authenticate
  - AuthClientId = tboprod
  - AuthUserName = IXMD112
  - AuthPassword = api-11#M$new
Hotel endpoints use the live production hotel credentials:
  - HotelUserName = IXMD112
  - HotelPassword = api-11#M$new
Verified live calls:
  - CountryList: success
  - CityList: success
  - TBOHotelCodeList: success with string IsDetailedResponse
  - Search: success
  - PreBook: live endpoint reached; sample codes returned Insufficient Balance
  - Authenticate: success on api.travelboutiqueonline.com with tboprod/IXMD112
Caveat: Book/GetBookingDetail/GenerateVoucher still need a valid booking token/flow and were not fully confirmed with these credentials.
